reviewNote: Draft based on common postnatal warning signs. Must be reviewed and localised by a qualified clinician before any release.

questions.label: Bleeding that soaks a pad in an hour, or large clots
Chest pain or sudden shortness of breath
Severe headache, or changes in your vision
Pain, swelling or redness in one leg
Stitches or wound that are red, hot, or leaking
A red, hot, painful breast with fever or chills
Thoughts of harming yourself or your baby
Measured temperature (°C), if you have one

rules.message: Very heavy bleeding needs emergency help now.
Chest pain or sudden breathlessness needs emergency help now.
You deserve support right now. Please talk to someone today. You are not alone, and this can get better with help.
A severe headache or vision changes after birth should be checked by a doctor urgently.
Pain or swelling in one leg should be checked by a doctor urgently.
A fever of 38°C or more after birth should be checked by a doctor today.
A red, hot or leaking wound is worth a call to your doctor or midwife today.
A red, hot, painful breast with fever is worth a call to your doctor or midwife today.
